notes.title: Update Announcement: Quality Upgrade!
notes.content:
Update Announcement: Quality Upgrade!

Hello, players!

We’re thrilled to bring you an update that enhances your gaming experience. Here's what's new in this release:

✨ Improved Visual Quality:

Upgraded textures, lighting, and overall graphics for a more immersive and atmospheric gameplay experience.
🎮 Enhanced Performance:

Optimized game performance to ensure smoother gameplay with fewer hiccups.
🔧 Bug Fixes:

Addressed minor glitches and improved stability based on your feedback.
This update will automatically queue for download if you have the game installed. Dive in and let us know what you think about the improved visuals and smoother performance!

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Your experience matters to us!

Stay spooky

tags.bug: - Addressed minor glitches and improved stability based on your feedback.

notes.title: Dr. Yaga Lost House v6.0
notes.content:
[h1]Updates for Dr. Yaga Lost House:[/h1]



[h2]Fixed Light Issue[/h2]

1: Resolved problems with lighting inconsistencies and improved overall brightness.
Fixed Enemy Idle Issue

2: Corrected the bug where enemies failed to react or move as intended.
Increased Graphic Quality

3: Enhanced textures, shadows, and rendering for a more immersive visual experience.
Added Show Effects

4: Introduced new visual effects to improve interactions and highlight key gameplay moments.
New Enemy Cooldown Slider

5: Added a slider option to adjust enemy cooldown settings, allowing for greater gameplay customization.

6: Cemetery Enemy Movement System
    - Implemented a unique mechanic where:
    - When the player sees the enemy: The enemy freezes and doesn't move.

notes.title: Dr. Yaga Lost House Launch
notes.content:
[h1]Dr. Yaga Lost House Launch[/h1]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145731/3fd191e0903060d3bd96c1966db7a7738e5bed1a.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145731/4f5c8a7dcacec030eef5af0e83f4a2964338188e.jpg[/img][/url]

The wait is almost over! We’re thrilled to announce the release of Dr. Yaga Lost House, our new horror FPS game, arriving in December. Prepare yourself for a journey filled with suspense, terror, and intense first-person gameplay. Explore haunted environments, uncover dark secrets, and confront terrifying enemies in a story that will keep you on the edge of your seat. This December, face your fears and dive into Dr. Yaga Lost House. Add us to your wishlist and be among the first to experience the horror!
